name: Faerie Ward
body:
School abjuration; Level cleric/oracle 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (powdered iron sprinkled on the creature to be warded)/DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Area 10-ft.-radius emanation centered on touched creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fortitude half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a magic circle that damages any fey creature currently in or entering the area. Affected creatures take 1d4 points of damage per 2 caster levels (maximum 5d4) on the start of their turn each round they remain in the area. A successful Fortitude save halves the damage. A Fortitude save can be made each round a creature is within the area.
